processed_milk.name: Pilk
processed_milk.flavorText: A carton of processed milk, or rather, a sweet, carbonated 'milk-based' beverage. Tastes better than you'd expect.

processed_juice.name: Puice
processed_juice.flavorText: A carton of processed juice. All the natural sugars have been extracted and replaced with refined sugars. Contains 0.1% real fruit juice!

processed_meat.name: Peat
processed_meat.flavorText: A can of salty processed meat made by Davre. It is cheap, available and filling. As long as one does not care about what type of meat it is made of.

bottled_water_premium.name: Bottle of Spring Water
bottled_water_premium.shortDescription: A sealed bottle of water supposedly drawn from a natural spring on a distant planet untouched by any industrial activity.
bottled_water_premium.flavorText: No one in the Lower Levels would drink this, even if they were dying of thirst, such is its value.

red_beer.name: Red Imp Beer
red_beer.flavorText: A popular beer brewed in the Lower Levels. Every batch tastes a bit different, but there is nothing cheaper. 3.5% ABV.

empty_beer_bottle.name: Empty Beer Bottle
empty_beer_bottle.shortDescription: Not a drop left. To prevent waste, brewers typically offer some kind of "buyback" program for their bottles.

liquid_luck.name: Liquid Luck
liquid_luck.flavorText: Will 100% increase your luck for 3 days! Georgio's guarantee! It tastes like Rustwater.

med_bottle_red.name: Bottle of Acidic Solution
med_bottle_red.shortDescription: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts bases.

med_bottle_blue.name: Bottle of Basic Solution
med_bottle_blue.shortDescription: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts acid.

med_bottle_violet.name: Bottle of N-Methylol Base
med_bottle_violet.shortDescription: A versatile chemical base used in many legitimate chemical manufacturing but also a common precursor for Phanta.

med_bottle_orange.name: Bottle of Reducing Agent
med_bottle_orange.flavorText: Donates electrons to another substance, changing the other substance's chemical state.

med_bottle_small_pink.name: Bottle of Lipobond Agent
med_bottle_small_pink.shortDescription: Clump Oils and Fat together allowing them to be filtered off easily. This agent can then be evaporate off.

1ml_dropper.name: 1ml Dropper
1ml_dropper.flavorText: A high-precision dropper for dispensing small amount of liquid.

soda_red.name: Soda
soda_red.shortDescription: A sweet carbonated beverage. On some parts of the Station, it's cheaper than clean water.

nudka.name: Nudka
nudka.shortDescription: A strong spirit made from Nutrifruit. Originally developed to be a heavy-duty paint stripper.

galaxy_blend.name: Galaxy Blend
galaxy_blend.flavorText: A nutritious puree made from pastel Inc.'s Nutrifruit and fortified with additional vitamins and minerals. One of the healthiest, and least popular foods available in the Lower Levels.

cat_bar.name: Cat Chocolate Bar
cat_bar.flavorText: A chocolate-covered wafer bar. Made to share, mostly eaten alone.

li_eat_snackbar.name: Li-Eat Snack Bar
li_eat_snackbar.shortDescription: A high protein chocolate flavored candy bar.

small_raw_meat.name: Raw Meat (Small)
small_raw_meat.shortDescription: A small piece of raw meat.
small_raw_meat.flavorText: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat (Standard)
raw_meat.flavorText: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

fat_meat.name: Animal Fat
fat_meat.shortDescription: A pound of suet. Cheap, and commonly used for rendering into tallow, or adding flavor to broths.

meat_scrap.name: Offal
meat_scrap.shortDescription: Organs, entrails, cartilage and trimming. While comestible and nutritious, is considered undesirable by most cuisines.

cup_noodle.name: Instant Ramen
cup_noodle.shortDescription: Contains a single use, flameless heater. Just add water for cooking.
cup_noodle.flavorText: Artificial Braised Beef Flavored. A certified Lower Levels classic. MSG, white pepper and Sichuan peppercorns give this instant noodle a spicy kick.

water_ration.name: Sealed Water Ration (Standard)
water_ration.shortDescription: Can be poured into a liquid container for 750ml of Basewater.
water_ration.flavorText: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

water_ration_small.name: Sealed Water Ration (Small)
water_ration_small.shortDescription: Can be poured into a liquid container for 375ml of Basewater.
water_ration_small.flavorText: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

processed_cheese.name: Processed Cheese
processed_cheese.flavorText: Holes are drilled into the cheese for the classic look, whilst also cutting production costs.

beis_icecream.name: Bei's Premium Vanilla Icecream
beis_icecream.shortDescription: Can be sold at a higher value when frozen overnight in the fridge.
beis_icecream.flavorText: A delicious treat that is legally categorized as Artificially Flavored Frozen Dairy Product. Somehow it doesn't melt when unrefrigerated.
